name: Thalamus (context envelope)
contextNote: Envelope/block tag for the thalamus silhouette on sagittal and coronal plates and in the 3D scene; not a nucleus record (see the 15 individual thalamic nucleus records). 3D representation: the paired GLB silhouettes ctx-thalamus-l and ctx-thalamus-r in src/assets/anatomy/anatomy-manifest.json (SceneLayers envelope slots; both slots select this id).

name: Hypothalamus (context envelope)
contextNote: Envelope/block tag for the hypothalamic wedge silhouette on the sagittal plate and in the 3D scene; not a nucleus record (see the individual hypothalamic nucleus records). 3D representation: the GLB silhouette ctx-hypothalamus-surface in src/assets/anatomy/anatomy-manifest.json (SceneLayers envelope slot).

name: Pineal body (context silhouette)
contextNote: 3D silhouette of the midline pineal-epithalamic block (GLB slug ctx-pineal in src/assets/anatomy/anatomy-manifest.json, SceneLayers envelope slot env-pineal). It is the renderable epithalamic body, NOT the endocrine pineal gland record nuc-pineal-gland, which carries the melatonin/clinical content; no plate carries this tag, so the id is reached in 3D and from the tree.

name: Superior cerebellar peduncle decussation
synonyms: decussation of the superior cerebellar peduncles

name: Oculomotor nerve (CN III) exit
synonyms: CN III rootlets in interpeduncular fossa

name: Trochlear nerve (CN IV) exit
synonyms: CN IV dorsal exit below inferior colliculus

name: Mesencephalon (context surface)
contextNote: 3D silhouette of the whole mesencephalon — tectum, tegmentum and crus cerebri as one renderable block (GLB slug ctx-midbrain-surface in src/assets/anatomy/anatomy-manifest.json, SceneLayers envelope slot env-midbrain). It is an envelope, not a nucleus record; the individual collicular, tegmental and peduncular records carry the content.

name: Trapezoid body
synonyms: auditory decussation of the caudal pons

Abducens nerve (CN VI) exit
synonyms: CN VI root at pontomedullary junction

name: Facial nerve (CN VII) exit
synonyms: CN VII/VIII root at cerebellopontine angle

name: Facial colliculus
synonyms: dorsal pontine bulge over abducens nucleus

name: Pons (context surface)
contextNote: 3D silhouette of the whole pons — basis pontis plus pontine tegmentum as one renderable block (GLB slug ctx-pons-surface in src/assets/anatomy/anatomy-manifest.json, SceneLayers envelope slot env-pons). It is an envelope, not a nucleus record; ctx-pontine-nuclei and ctx-pontine-fibers are the plate-2D sub-tags of its ventral part and appear on the pontine plates.

name: Dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus (CN X)
Medullary reticular formation
synonyms: central/medial reticular nuclei of the medulla

name: Accessory nerve (CN XI) exit
synonyms: cranial and spinal roots of CN XI

name: Obex
synonyms: caudal apex of the fourth ventricle

name: Medulla (context surface)
contextNote: 3D silhouette of the whole medulla oblongata — pyramids, olives, the dorsal column tubercles and the open fourth-ventricle floor as one renderable block (GLB slug ctx-medulla-surface in src/assets/anatomy/anatomy-manifest.json, SceneLayers envelope slot env-medulla). It is an envelope, not a nucleus record; the pyramid, olive, dorsal-column and cranial-nerve-exit records carry the content.

name: Cerebellar hemispheres and vermis (context)
contextNote: Envelope of the cerebellum — two lateral hemispheres joined by the midline vermis. 3D representation: three GLB silhouettes, ctx-cerebellum-l, ctx-cerebellum-r and ctx-cerebellar-vermis in src/assets/anatomy/anatomy-manifest.json; all three SceneLayers envelope slots select this id, while the deep nuclei and the vermis surface carry their own records (nuc-dentate/nuc-interposed/nuc-fastigial, surf-vermis).
